scenes.caption: Two words often used as one.
scenes.say: Myth or fact? A budget and a forecast are the same thing.
cap: A *budget* and a *forecast* are the same thing.

scenes.head: Budget stays. Forecast moves.
scenes.src: Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.say: Not quite. A budget is the plan the board approves for the year. A forecast is your latest view of what will actually happen, updated as the year moves.
cap: A *budget* is the plan the board approves for the year.
A *forecast* is your latest view of what will actually happen, updated as the year moves.

scenes.say: Keep the budget as the target, and use the forecast to decide what to do next.
cap: Keep the budget as the *target*, and use the forecast to *decide what to do next*.

scenes.q: Do you forecast, or only budget?
scenes.disc: General information only, not legal or tax advice. Illustrative example, not a real company.
scenes.say: Our fractional C.F.O. service sets up both with you. Want a clearer view of your year? Message us on WhatsApp.
cap: Our fractional CFO service sets up both with you.
